translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Umpomakaleso pa'palakoanna Petrus dio olona jumaa' dio Yerusalem
Tappa nahingngi duka' kaheba ingganna suhona Puang Yesus sola to matappa' dio lembäna Yudea naua budam tau taianna to Yahudi untahima Battakadanna Puang Allataala.
Sapo' sipengka Petrus anna to Yahudi to matappa'um sulena längäm Yerusalem.
Keaha'i lako Petrus naua: “Akanna tama hako iko banuanna tau taia to Yahudi anna sola-solakoa' mangngande?”
Nasuhum napahandu' pole' Petrus ma'tula' napomakalesoam indo puha dadi mengkalao dio pa'pahandusanna naua:
“Mahassannä' ma'sambajam dio Yope, pissananna kusi'dim dilipi anna kuita tuhum yabo mai langi' susi sampim kallu'bä' dipetoke'i appa' sikunna, dilolloham yabo mai tihandu' dio oloku.
Tappa kulio-lio, iya kuitam ma'hupa-hupa olo'-olo' ma'bitti' appa', olo'-olo' malaiha, olo'-olo' tissollo' anna ma'hupa-hupa dassi.
Iya kuhingngim kamaha naua: ‘O Petrus, bangongko, tunui anna muande asanni.’
Sapo' kutimba'i kuua: ‘Tä' sugali' ia pole' Debata, aka pempom dadingku tä' punalapi deem kuande kinande indo dipemaliinna la diande.’
Iya kuhingngi pole oom indo kamaha yabo mai langi' naua: ‘Ingganna napemapiaanna Puang Allataala, tä' mala la napemalii hupatau.’
Pentallum nasulei ma'pateem, anna mane tiäkä' asam sule längäm langi'.
Wattu eta too, sule siaham duka' tallu tau dio indo olo banua to kiongei tohho to mengkalao inde Kaisarea, indo to disua untambaiä'.
Kuhingngi kamaha ma'kada naua: ‘Le'ba'koa' sola, daa umpomabanda' penabammu moi anna muissam muua taia to Yahudi.’ Iya indem annam solaku kupasola indo anna le'ba'kam tama banuanna Kornelius.
Iya natulasammakanni indo puha muita mesa malaika' ke'de' illaam banuanna anna nauaanni: ‘Suai tau lako Yope la untambai mesa tau isanga Simon si diuaam Petrus.
Aka la natulasangkoa' kaheba la umpasalama'ko sola ingganna sahapummu.’
Kupahandu'na ma'tula', iya tuhummi Penaba Maseho umponnoi asanni susi duka' indo uhuna nalambi'kia'.
Iya tappa kukilalai tula'na Debata indo anna si nauai: ‘Yohanes uwai ia napake mantedo', sapo' ikoa'-iko la ditedo'koa' Penaba Maseho.’
Dadi maka' la namana' duka' Penaba Maseho Puang Allataala tau taianna to Yahudi susi kitaa' anna uhunai ungkatappa'ikia' Debatanta Yesus Kristus, iya tä' deem lalanna la kulabai.”

Iya tappana nahingngi kaha-kaha ia too sangngim mengkamma'um anna umpa'kasallei Puang Allataala naua: “Nabeem dia duka' lalam Puang Allataala tau taianna to Yahudi la untihokongam gau'na anna mala ullambi' katuboam.”
Jumaa' uhu-uhuna dio Antiokhia

Indo puhanna dipatei Stefanus iya kende'um pandahhaam napolalam tisembu' ingganna to matappa'; deem lu lako Fenisia, deem lu lako Siprus, anna deem lu lako Antiokhia. Iya tontä liu duka' umpa'pakahebaam Kaheba Katilallasam sapo' anggam lu lako to Yahudi.

Sapo' illaam alla'-alla'na indo to matappa' deem duka' to buttu dio mai Siprus anna Kirene. Indo tau, le'ba' lako ia Antiokhia untulasam Kaheba Katilallasam tau taianna to Yahudi naua: “Indo Puang Yesus iam too Debata.”
Iya natette liu anna naolaam Debata nasuhum tuttuam buda tau matappa' anna untuhu'i Puang Yesus.
Tappana napelele ingganna to matappa' dio Yerusalem kaheba ia too, iya ussua siaham Barnabas le'ba' lako Antiokhia.

Indo Barnabas mesa tau mapia anna to matappa' si'da-si'da naponnoi Penaba Maseho. Iya sulena lako, tappa tilalla' muita ingganna to matappa' dio natamba' ponno duka' Puang Allataala. Iya napakahi'di asammi naua: “La tontä liukoa' manontom lako Debata sola sakalebu penabammu.” Napolalam tuttuam buda tau mentuhu' lako Puang Yesus.
Le'ba' lako Tarsus Barnabas umpeä Saulus.

Tappana silambi', iya napasolam lako Antiokhia. Dio Antiokhia sataum naolaam si ma'hempum liu sola ingganna to matappa' anna umpa'guhu tau buda. Iya diom too Antiokhia uhu-uhuna to matappa' disangai “to Sahani”.
Wattu eta too sule dio Antiokhia sanaka-naka nabi buttu yabo mai Yerusalem.
Indo Mesa isanga Agabus napalosai Penaba Maseho lambi' ke'de' ma'kada naua: “La kende' kakobeam lako lino.” Kaha-kaha ia too dadi wattunna Klaudius ma'takka' dio kahajaam Roma.
Iya eta too muala kattuam ingganna to matappa' la uhhempum aka-aka situhu' kapallambisanna aka la napamoloiam solasubunna to matappa' dio Yudea.
Tihempunni, iya nabehom lako Barnabas sola Saulus aka ia la umpalambi'i lako pebaba ada'na to matappa' dio Yudea.
